# GC-STEM Issue Templates

This folder contains issue templates for the GC-STEM repository ecosystem. Issue templates help standardize the information provided when creating new issues, making it easier for maintainers to triage and address them efficiently.

## Report an Accessibility Barrier

Use this template to report any accessibility barriers you encounter within the GC-STEM repository ecosystem. This helps maintainers identify and address accessibility issues effectively.

## Report a Bug

Use this template to report any bugs you encounter within the GC-STEM repository ecosystem. This helps maintainers identify and address issues effectively.
